title: Chicken Tagine Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional Mexican street food, combining the flavors of Moroccan chicken tagine with crispy tacos.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, then sauté the onions and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Moroccan spice blend and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, red wine (if using), and browned chicken. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by slicing the chicken and serving it in the warmed tortillas, topped with avocado and a squeeze of lime juice.
